description: Ports Resilience Index is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Mississippi-Alabama Sea Grant Consortium; Louisiana Sea Grant; Gulf of America Alliance. Port management organizations can use this self-assessment to determine if they are prepared to maintain operations during and after disasters. Coastal seaports and inland river ports can use the tool to identify strengths and weaknesses in their management and operations. These indicators can provide an important baseline by which to measure progress toward resilience goals. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
